messages:
mei.chen: Heads up 1 1 Returning from parental leave on Jan 10 and trying to use some unused PTO that fell into the shutdown. I had 24h carried into this year last year when I went on leave. Manager approved new dates but wants to confirm proration since I'm switching to 0.8 FTE on return. Can I keep all 24h carryover or will proration reduce it?
hr-bot: Policy reminder: carryover cap = 40h. Proration applies to future accruals only; prior-year carryover amounts are preserved unless a role change triggers policy exception. See: https://redwood.company/policies/pto#carryover-proration
dante_mgr: My read: we approved the time and told Mei to keep 24h. But because she's moving to 0.8 FTE her ongoing accruals will be prorated. People Ops should confirm whether the carryover balance is impacted.
olivia-peopleops: Important nuance: carryover is not normally reduced for FTE changes. However, for mid-year FTE reduction that happened before carryover processing we need to verify cutoff dates. Which date did the FTE change become effective?
mei.chen: New contract effective Jan 10 (first day back). So FTE change happens after year-end. I stayed on leave through Dec and then come back part-time.
ulogia: hmm
julia.payroll: Payroll/process note: year-end carryover processing ran Jan 2, so the 24h was applied to Mei's balance at that time under full-time status. If her contract change is effective Jan 10, the carried hours already posted and shouldn't be clawed back.
olivia-peopleops: To be safe we'll need manager confirmation and an audit note on Lattice. Dante, can you add a comment: "FTE change effective Jan 10; approved carryover preserved per People Ops pending payroll confirmation"?
dante_mgr: Adding comment now.
mei.chen: Thanks. Also quick question 1: I have a planned international trip that covers Jan 12-16 and those days overlap with the company holiday on Jan 15 (regional office observance). Do I need to mark that as PTO or is the holiday subtracted?
hr-bot: Company-observed holidays are not charged against employee PTO when they fall on a scheduled workday. If the employee is part-time and the holiday falls on a non-workday per their schedule, we pro-rate. See holiday rules: https://redwood.company/policies/holidays
julia.payroll: For a 0.8 FTE schedule we'll need to confirm Mei's standard workdays. If Jan 15 is a scheduled workday for her, the holiday will be applied and not use PTO. If not, she'll use PTO for those days. Please confirm schedule.
mei.chen: My schedule will be Mon-Fri but 8am-4:30pm (reduced hours). Jan 15 is a Mon so should be a holiday for me.
olivia-peopleops: Good. Two action items: 1) Dante add Lattice comment (done), 2) People Ops to mark carryover_preserved and note FTE change effective date. We'll create a ticket to reconcile with payroll.
hr-bot: people-ops ticket created: #PO-5132 1 olivia-peopleops assigned. Link: https://redwood.company/people-ops/tickets/PO-5132
julia.payroll: We'll run a manual check during Jan payroll to ensure carryover wasn't affected and confirm holiday handling. Encashment not relevant here.
dante_mgr: Confirmed comment added and told Mei that her 24h carryover stands. Congrats on the new schedule! :tada:
mei.chen: Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick clarity. I'll DM if anything else pops up.
